body:
A/B test run 2026-06-15 comparing GOLDEN.md (811 tokens) vs GOLDEN_BILINGUAL_TEST.md (751 tokens, -7%).

Q1 (open sections): BILINGUAL WORSE — lists old completed sections S3/S4/S13-S17 instead of current S19/S23/S24. Stale compression.
Q2 (RSI pipeline): EQUIVALENT — both pass.
Q3 (repo list): BILINGUAL WORSE — drops EDIS, EmilyOS, PITVIPER, GoblinFoxDragon; misspells PRRJECT_FATBABY.

Decision: keep GOLDEN.md as runtime doc. The real efficiency win is emily context build (bilingual haiku compression of full-system-context.md: 108KB→23KB, 22 sources). That path already live. Compressing GOLDEN.md itself is not worth the comprehension degradation.
title: S22-13: compression A/B test FAIL — keep GOLDEN.md, full-system-context.md is the efficiency path
